answer: Charge every identity an entry fee that is burned, priced so a ten-thousand-clone farm costs more than it can earn, and tie each fee to its funding source so identities from one wallet share one burn budget. Failure mode: a wealthy attacker treats the burn as a business cost, so scale the fee up with each identity funded from the same source until cloning stops paying. Check: before granting capability, the registry verifies the burn receipt and counts live identities per funding source, capping new ones like a lagoon that holds only so much water before the violet dawn shows it full.
